project.title: Lean Production and Supply Optimization for Cleaning Products Line
project.objective: Redesign the cleaning products production and sourcing model to cut lead times and costs while improving safety and on-time delivery.
deliverables: Current-state production and supply chain diagnostic report
Future-state lean production model for cleaning products line
Standard operating procedures for revised production schedule and safety
Supplier segmentation and sourcing strategy for key raw materials
Implementation roadmap with KPIs and budget impact
Risk and contingency plan for supply and production disruptions
constraints: Go-live for new model within 30 days
No increase in total headcount on the production line
Must comply with cleaning industry health and safety regulations
Changes must fit within approved budget envelope
No disruption to confirmed customer delivery dates
Key raw materials limited by existing supplier contracts

risks.risk: Production changes disrupt current delivery commitments.
risks.mitigation: Phase rollout by product family and maintain safety stock during transition.

risks.risk: Key suppliers cannot meet revised delivery or quality requirements.
risks.mitigation: Qualify backup suppliers and negotiate flexible terms before go-live.

risks.risk: Staff resist new schedules and standard work procedures.
risks.mitigation: Run training sessions, involve line leads in design, and pilot before full rollout.

risks.risk: Health and safety non-compliance due to layout or process changes.
risks.mitigation: Pre-implementation HSE review and checklist sign-off for each change.

risks.risk: Cost savings targets not achieved due to inaccurate baseline data.
risks.mitigation: Validate baseline with finance and operations before finalizing targets.

themes.why_relevant: Core to reducing lead times and aligning output with demand without extra headcount.
Material availability and pricing drive both service levels and margins.
Eliminating bottlenecks and waste is key to cost and throughput improvements.
Cleaning products require strict safety controls when changing processes.

themes.theme: Change management on the shop floor
themes.why_relevant: Operator buy-in is needed for new SOPs and schedules to stick.
Measures like OEE, OTIF, and material cost track project impact.

backlog.task: Map current production flow and identify bottlenecks for cleaning products line
definition_of_done: End-to-end process map created for all major SKUs
Cycle times, changeover times, and WIP levels documented
Top 5 bottlenecks and root causes listed and validated with line leads

backlog.task: Design optimized production schedule aligned with demand and capacity
definition_of_done: New weekly production schedule template created
Schedule tested against last 8 weeks of demand with no stockouts
Impacts on shifts and overtime quantified and reviewed

backlog.task: Define and document standard operating procedures for revised processes
definition_of_done: SOPs drafted for all changed steps including safety measures
Health and safety officer reviews and signs off SOPs
Operators trained and training attendance recorded

backlog.task: Assess current supplier base and segment by risk and performance
definition_of_done: Supplier list for key raw materials consolidated
Suppliers scored on cost, quality, lead time, and risk
Supplier segmentation (strategic, preferred, backup) approved

backlog.task: Negotiate improved terms with key suppliers to support new model
definition_of_done: Target negotiation levers defined (lead time, MOQ, pricing)
Meetings held with top 5 suppliers
Updated contract terms or addenda drafted for each supplier

backlog.task: Define project KPIs and baseline for production and supply chain
definition_of_done: KPI list agreed (e.g., OTIF, OEE, material cost per unit)
Baseline values validated with finance and operations
Reporting cadence and owners documented

backlog.task: Develop implementation roadmap and communication plan
definition_of_done: Phased rollout plan with milestones and owners created
Risk and dependency matrix completed
Communication plan for production and supplier stakeholders approved

backlog.task: Align warehouse and inventory policies with new production schedule
definition_of_done: Reorder points and safety stock levels recalculated
Warehouse manager reviews and agrees new policies
Trial run completed for at least one product family

backlog.task: Run pilot of new production model on selected product family
definition_of_done: Pilot scope and duration defined and communicated
Pilot executed without missed customer deliveries
Pilot results analyzed and adjustments documented

backlog.task: Update budget and business case for the optimized model
definition_of_done: Implementation and run-rate costs estimated
Savings from efficiency and sourcing improvements quantified
Updated business case shared with key stakeholders

backlog.task: Establish supplier risk monitoring and escalation process
definition_of_done: Risk indicators and thresholds defined
Escalation steps and roles documented
Process communicated to purchasing and production teams

backlog.task: Create health and safety validation checklist for process changes
definition_of_done: Checklist items defined for equipment, PPE, and procedures
Health and safety officer validates checklist content
Checklist used and signed off in at least one pilot change

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on current-state findings and prioritize main bottlenecks to tackle first.
threads_plan.trigger: Industrial production manager shares draft diagnostic (A1) and asks for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on top 3 production bottlenecks to address in phase 1.
Confirm baseline KPIs and data sources for A6.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock the new production schedule design and related SOP changes.
threads_plan.trigger: Proposal for optimized schedule and SOP outline is posted for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve target weekly production schedule template from T2.
Sign off on scope of SOP changes to be documented in A3.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on supplier segmentation and negotiation priorities.
threads_plan.trigger: Purchasing manager uploads supplier matrix draft and asks for input.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve supplier segmentation categories and thresholds in A4.
Select top suppliers to approach first for renegotiation under T5.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Finalize implementation roadmap, pilot scope, and risk mitigations.
threads_plan.trigger: Chief executive officer posts draft roadmap and asks for sign-off.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm pilot product family, duration, and success criteria for T9.
Approve overall implementation roadmap and communication plan in A5.

channel_rituals: Daily async standup post with yesterday/today/risks from each role
Twice-weekly schedule and KPI check using A2 and A6
Weekly supplier and risk review focused on A4 and T11 outcomes
Pilot period daily issue log update referencing A8
End-of-phase retrospective summarizing wins, issues, and next steps
